title: More at Stake: How Payoff and Language Shape LLM Agent Strategies in Cooperation Dilemmas

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM agents in a repeated Prisoner's Dilemma game using prompts translated into five different languages (English, French, Arabic, Mandarin Chinese, and Vietnamese) to measure cross-linguistic divergences in strategic behavior, cooperation rates, and penalty outcomes.

Analyzing the strategy distributions (e.g., Always Defect, Tit-for-Tat) across different languages to infer embedded cultural values and norms, such as Anglo-centric hyper-competitiveness versus community-oriented or relational fairness behaviors in other linguistic contexts.
